snippet.title: Official Pre-Alpha Tech Test Trailer | Zeverland
snippet.description:
Future Survivors: 
Thank you for enduring the long wait! 
It's finally about to begin! Our first pre-alpha tech test!
If you want to explore Zeverland, join our Discord and fill out the tester recruitment survey. The test will start on November 14. 
Hope to see you there! 🤗
Our Discord invite link will be put in the comments. 👇
Also, you can now wishlist the game on Steam.
——————————
Welcome to Zeverland! Ever since the Red Rain started falling, things have looked a little different... Your phone has zero bars, all the local delivery places are closed, and your neighbors have turned into ravenous, flesh-eating Zeds. But you'll be fine—you've got common sense and a vivid imagination. Anything in your house can be a weapon if you try hard enough. You'll cut quite a figure out there with your toilet brush sword and your toilet lid shield. If you're feeling especially charitable, you could even help save the world! In Zeverland, you won't be facing a society that's starting to recover—because it was only just destroyed. If the world's gonna be saved, you'll have to be the one to save it.

#Zeverland #QuantumQuirks
